items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: you got the principals, you got the chorus girls, you know, that's the show in those days. They're all lined up. You get those things with dancing and Tom Whaley's directing, you know, and everybody is trying to get together.

ctx.x: Well, Fats was a tremendous musician, as you know. And, during the rehearsal he'd get the shows together and to lead the shows off, there's afellow that's a conductor there that by the name of Tom Hurley.

Yeah, Tom Whaley. We always speak of him as a fine musician. I think he's working with the Duke now. And, we saw sometimes, maybe whenever we got in town, 4 o'clock in the morning, 5 o'clock in the morning... rehearsal down near the time had for show time. MW after leaving Henderson, who I thought he was the greatest band in the world.
